claire: Action items: devin => conservative spend slide (median+90th); eng-enable => finalize invites + prework; sam => AB test plan and expected cost delta; CS => propose retainer cushion (recommendation: max(15% of 90th, shortfall)). Need slides by EOD tomorrow.
billing-bot: NOTE: Draft budget alert rule created at 80% of proposed retainer: https://redwood.app/alerts/88-202
claire: Thanks — ping me 1:1 for blockers. :thumbsup:
